submission.natural_language_explanation: EleutherAI/pythia-70m L0/H0 is a sharp-attention, sequence-start head: its write leaves its mean only where its attention is concentrated on one or two tokens whose values are unlike the average token, strongest (0.9-1.0 of max) on a full stop '.' at position 1-3; a period anywhere in roughly the first 25 positions (sentence end, abbreviation, decimal, version number or file path alike), the full-width '。', or a bracket '(' ')' '[' ']' '{' '}' in the first four positions still clears the line (0.25-0.9 of max), and the first three or four tokens of any text sit weakly at 0.15-0.45 of max because the attention there is split only between the first token and itself. Therefore predict active any text containing such a period or early bracket, or having an auxiliary ('was', 'were', 'is') or a high-write content token among its first four tokens, and predict inactive a period-free, bracket-free clause of 12-30 tokens that opens 'According to <common noun phrase>' in common words, e.g. 'According to the map the nearest petrol station is about twenty miles away' (0.18 of max), because commas, colons, semicolons, quotes, dashes, digits and ordinary words past the fourth position stay below the line on their own.

rival_explanations: A generic punctuation/whitespace-boundary head: it fires equally on commas, colons, semicolons, quotes and dashes as on periods and brackets, so a comma- or semicolon-chained list should be as active as a period-rich sentence and the punctuation identity should not matter.

A pure position head: its strength is set only by absolute position and the first two tokens, so a period deep in a long text (past position ~10) should not keep a text active, while any text with a bright opening (e.g. 'It was...') should be active regardless of punctuation.

A rare-token head: it fires on any token whose embedding is far from the corpus mean (proper names, technical terms, rare subwords), so a mid-text cluster of rare names or technical terms should fire strongly even with no punctuation or sequence-start position.
